content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text decides the Acts 2:30 link by comparing the defender's chain answer with the challenger's chain press and calling the result underdetermined.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"neither chain forces the other.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"none","why":"The judge weighs the competing chains against each other and does not demand that a single verse state the contrary."}
